messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@brightfin.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Greenroom buddy rotation + demo ownership for BrightFin webinar

Hi Hannah —

Quick one as we lock the run-of-show for the July 14 BrightFin / Redwood webinar. We have two guest presenters (BrightFin PM + CTO) and your internal SME demo slot at 11:10 PT. Can you confirm: 1) who will be the greenroom buddy to shepherd your speaker from pre-show into the stage? 2) who owns the demo handoff (slides -> live demo -> code demo)?

We want explicit owner names so our stage manager can ping people during the warm-up window (10:40–11:00).

Also attaching a simple run sheet template if useful.

Thanks,
Olivia
BrightFin Events
Attachment: brightfin_run_sheet_template.csv (csv)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Greenroom buddy rotation + demo ownership for BrightFin webinar

Hi Olivia —

Thanks — yes, we can codify owners. Proposed plan below:

- Greenroom buddy: Lauren Bishop will be the point for presenter logistics (pre-check, mic, slides, intro line). She'll be in the greenroom from 10:30.
- Demo owner: Mateo Alvarez will own the live demo flow (slides -> local demo -> API key swap) and be responsible for the short handoff script.
- Technical fallback: Karthik will be on-call for model/connectivity fallbacks and will monitor the demo environment starting at 10:45.

Action items for BrightFin: please confirm the presenter arrival window and whether you need us to take presenter bios on the greenroom call.

I'll attach our current run sheet and the latest slides.

Best,
Hannah
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
Attachment: greenroom_run_sheet_v1.csv (csv), redwood_live-demo-slides_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>

Quick follow — a couple practical notes from greenroom ops: 

- I'll run a staggered greenroom check: 10:30–10:40 brief (audio/camera), 10:40–10:50 for slides handoff/check, 10:50–11:00 quick run through of the handoff sentence and Q&A routing.
- Buddy rotation: if Lauren is engaged with another presenter at 10:30, Hannah can step in for the first 10 minutes, then I take over at 10:40. We'll publish a 2-line escalation matrix so stage manager knows who to ping.
- Mic/test: Mateo, please bring a wired mic and confirm Zoom audio levels by 10:35.

I put the suggested 2-line handoff below that we can read on-air: 
"Next up, our demo will be presented by Mateo Alvarez from Redwood Inference. Mateo — you'll take the screen and walk us through a five-minute live demo, then return to slides for the next segment"

I'll prep the run sheet CSV (attached) with these windows filled.

Thanks —
Lauren
Senior Events Producer, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia@brightfin.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T12:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Greenroom buddy rotation + demo ownership for BrightFin webinar

Adding technical constraints for the handoff/fallbacks: 

- Demo environment: we'll run the live demo against a sandbox on Redwood Dedicated. Mateo, I'll provide a read-only API key that limits token throughput — please don't paste a production key into the run.
- Connectivity window: plan to begin stream share at 11:06 to allow 4 minutes of context before the live demo at 11:10. If the sandbox shows latency > 350ms median in the 10:50–11:05 check, fallback to the recorded demo video (we have a 90-second cut).
- KV cache: if you're walking through a multi-step prompt sequence, bring the prompt set in the slide notes so I can preload the KV cache before you go live.
- Logs & tracing: I'll enable a short trace capture during the demo window; post-event we'll share a 48-hour trace export for ops.

I'll upload a small tech checklist to the Drive folder and paste the API key to the secure doc for Mateo.

-Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: tech_checklist.txt (text)
